loop.task: Raise the share of held-out messages to a bank's support whose intent the fine-tuned language model names exactly. train.py fine-tunes the small chat model in model/ on data/train.txt. A run trains for 30 seconds (--time-budget 30, fixed) and must save a PEFT LoRA adapter for that base model into adapter/ of its run directory the way train.py does now (adapter_config.json and adapter_model.safetensors); the frozen evaluate.py loads it onto the base model and scores the answers the model generates. Everything inside train.py may change: rank and target modules of the adapter, optimiser, schedule, precision, batching, how the training texts are built from data/train.txt. The base model, the prompt in evaluate.py and the data may not.
